question: Which benevolent and auspicious aspects of Śiva receive repeated obeisance?
premises: Obeisance is directed to the joy-making aspect.
Obeisance is directed to the auspicious aspect.
Obeisance is directed to the more auspicious aspect.
inference: Multiple benevolent and auspicious aspects of Śiva are honored with salutation.
plain_english: Obeisance to the joy-maker, and obeisance to the auspicious one, and to the even more auspicious one.
